matches.description: Watch Toronto FC vs Nashville SC highlights and goals from Major League Soccer on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on September 10, 2026. The MLS clash between Seattle Sounders FC and Nashville SC promised to be a tactical chess match as both sides looked to assert their dominance in the league standings. Fans gathered on September 10, 2026 , expecting a high-energy performance from two of the league's most disciplined rosters. Tactical Discipline and Early Adjustments The match began with a cagey atmosphere, as both teams prioritized defensive solidity over all-out attack. The first half was defined by physical duels in the center of the park, leading to several interruptions in play. Nashville SC was forced into an early tactical change in the 37th minute when Snyder Brunell replaced Kalani Rienzi . As the half drew to a close, the intensity boiled over, resulting in a yellow card for Ronald Donkor during stoppage time, setting the tone for a gritty second period. Flurry of Changes in the Second Half As the second half got underway, the managers turned to their benches to find a breakthrough. Seattle Sounders FC introduced Sebastian Gomez for Jordan Morris early on, hoping to inject new life into the forward line. However, the game remained tightly contested, with Justin Che and Julian Bazan both entering the referee's book as they looked to halt opposition momentum. A series of high-profile substitutions followed, including the introduction of Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting and Emil Forsberg , as both sides searched for that elusive moment of brilliance. Gritty Conclusion in Seattle The final fifteen minutes saw a frantic exchange of possession and tactical positioning. Paul Rothrock received a yellow card in the 81st minute before being replaced by Paul Arriola , while Nashville SC looked to maintain their shape with the inclusion of Devin Padelford . Despite the late pressure and fresh legs on the pitch, neither side could find the decisive opening. The referee blew the final whistle after five minutes of added time, concluding a hard-fought encounter where defensive resilience was the ultimate winner.
